title: Unattended merge on green CI
summary: Squash-merges every pull request whose CI run is green, pinned to the commit CI validated; docs-only pull requests merge at once. Never merges unattended what touches Claude instruction files, a CI Claude session's branch, or a Dependabot bump the gate holds.

CI_WORKFLOW.prompt: Name of the CI workflow that must be green before a merge (its `name:`)

postInstall: The workflow auto-merge waits for (the name given at install, "CI" by default) must exist under that exact `name:`, run on pull_request, and ignore docs/**, **.md, LICENSE and .gitignore on push and pull_request — otherwise a docs-only pull request merges while its CI is still running.

Fill the three TODO(harness) comments in .github/workflows/auto-merge.yml: the paths that are executed (CLAUDE_GATE_RE), where a Dependabot major may go through (MAJOR_HOLD_RE, every major is held as shipped), and whether something must be dispatched after a merge.

A merge made by this workflow emits no push event: anything that deploys or tests on push to the default branch will not run after it. docs/conventions/auto-merge-policy.md § After the merge says how to add a dispatch.
